xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF for #3180 platform status probe + outage attribution for CI weather

plan.title: feat(scm,ci): platform status probe + outage attribution for CI weather handoffs

narratives.Description: pr:watch and review-cycle now name CI weather symptoms (#3167) and workflow failover arms on Blacksmith capacity death (#3168), but agents still lack a MUST probe of public status pages to attribute holds to upstream outage vs repo config. This story adds playbook + handoff fields and surfaces static status URLs on weather-class gate output without auto-merge from status alone.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Document MUST probe sequence (GitHub Status Actions/Webhooks + Blacksmith Status) and attribution table (platform vs capacity vs repo_config) in content/scm/github.md and content/skills/deft-directive-review-cycle/SKILL.md CI weather / BLOCKED section; anti-patterns for workflow thrash during attributed platform outage.
2. Surface static status page URLs in pr:watch / pr:merge-ready human and JSON output when ci_ready_state is weather-class (packages/core/src/pr-watch and pr-merge-readiness); no network fetch required for v1.
3. Cross-link #3167, #3168, #2672, #2688; content or unit test pins for key tokens; CHANGELOG [Unreleased] for #3180; verify with core tests and task check.
narratives.UserStory: As a review-cycle owner blocked on ci_never_scheduled, I want status-page probe and attribution rules, so that I wait on platform incidents instead of thrashing workflows or empty commits.
narratives.Overview: Extends #3167; related #3168/#2672/#2688. Static URLs for v1; optional Statuspage API later.
narratives.Labels: enhancement, ci-cd, determinism, agent-experience, harness, scm, area:guidance

items.title: Document MUST status-page probe and attribution

narrative.Acceptance: Given CI weather codes or CI never starts for HEAD, when agents follow scm/github.md and review-cycle, then they MUST probe GitHub Status and Blacksmith Status and apply the platform vs capacity vs repo_config attribution table with anti-thrash rules during platform outage.

items.title: Gate output surfaces status URLs on weather states

narrative.Acceptance: Given pr:watch or pr:merge-ready with weather-class ci_ready_state, when JSON or human output is emitted, then static GitHub and Blacksmith status page URLs are included (network fetch not required for v1).
Given a BLOCKED: ci_weather handoff, when written per review-cycle, then it includes platform_status_github, platform_status_blacksmith, optional incident URL, and attribution enum fields.

expected_outputs: pr:watch weather output includes status URLs
